newsitem.title: USA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-ANAHEIM'S DAIGNEAULT SUSPENDED FOR 10 GAMES.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-ANAHEIM'S DAIGNEAULT SUSPENDED FOR 10 GAMES.

text.p: Mighty Ducks of Anaheim defenceman J.J. Daigneault has been automatically suspended for 10 games without pay and fined $1,000 for abusing an official, the National Hockey League said Wednesday.
Daigneault struck referee Don Koharski with his stick in Sunday's game against Vancouver following an accidental collision with the official. A subsequent swing of his stick did not make contact.

"Although the initial slash by Mr Daigneault appeared to be reactionary after the collision with referee Koharski, the contact was serious enough to warrant this suspension," NHL senior vice president Brian Burke said in a statement.
"The second slash, although there was no contact made, was clearly deliberate."
The suspension will last through the Ducks' March 19 game against the Los Angeles Kings.
Burke concluded the statement saying "physical abuse of an official will not be tolerated."
